176-3967-4875.easyPrerequisites:

176-3967-4875.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Requiem Angel triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token. The token won't be a Soldier due to Conspiracy.
Resolve the Yahenni ability, giving Yahenni indestructible until end of turn.

2317-6664-7084-8227.notablePrerequisites: You have at least seven cards in your graveyard.

When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending Dwarven Mine.
Resolve the Loot ability, giving Loot -2/-0 until end of turn
Activate Loot by sacrificing Dwarven Mine.
When Dwarven Mine dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning Dwarven Mine from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to The Wandering Minstrel
When Dwarven Mine enters, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Dwarf creature token.
Resolve the Loot ability, giving Loot -2/-0 until end of turn
Repeat.

602-4691-7178.easyPrerequisites: You have a card in hand.
602-4691-7178.description:
Activate Iron-Shield Elf by discarding a card.
Feast of Sanity triggers, dealing 1 damage to you and causing you to gain 1 life.
Vilis triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Iron-Shield Elf ability, giving Iron-Shield Elf indestructible until end of turn and tapping it
Repeat

2577-5478-6797-7084.easyPrerequisites:
You control another Zombie.
You control a land that can tap to produce at least {B}.
2577-5478-6797-7084.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Gravecrawler.
When Gravecrawler dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land that can tap to produce at least {B}.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Spelunking.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Activate the land by tapping it, adding at least {B}.
Cast Gravecrawler from your graveyard by paying {B}.
Repeat.
2577-5478-6797-7084.notes: An infinite card draw result has been added to this combo due to Cultivator Colossus or a similar card. This likely limits the other results based on the number of cards in your library.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

6972-7155-8095.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Arcbound Fiend.
When Arcbound Fiend dies, its modular ability and persist ability trigger.
Resolve the modular trigger, putting Arcbound Fiend's +1/+1 counters on another artifact creature.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning Arcbound Fiend from your graveyard to the battlefield. It will not have a -1/-1 counter on it due to its modular ability.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Repeat.

2034-4289-6791-6970-7850.description:
Cast Abby from the command zone by paying {1}{R}{G} plus commander tax if applicable.
Abby triggers, creating a number of 1/1 Fungus Zombie creature tokens named Cordyceps Infected equal to the amount of mana spent to cast it.
When Abby enters under an opponent's control, Mirror of Life Trapping triggers, exiling Abby.
Choose to return Abby from exile to the command zone.
Activate two Codryceps Infected tokens by tapping them, adding {R}{G}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a Cordyceps Infected token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat step 6 until you have enough mana to cast Abby.
Repeat from step 1.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

1183-5330-6972.description:
Activate Atog by sacrificing Pentavus.
When Pentavus dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Atog ability.
Repeat.

1116-1263-2511-4871.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Bloodsoaked Champion.
When Bloodsoaked Champion dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Sek'Kuar trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Bloodsoaked Champion by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

129-1409-1849-3755.description:
Activate Deadeye Navigator by tapping it, adding {U}.
Kinnan triggers, adding {U}.
Activate Deadeye Navigator by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Deadeye Navigator enters the battlefield, its soulbond ability triggers, repairing it with another creature.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

1322-3259-7752.easyPrerequisites: You've cast a noncreature spell this turn.
1322-3259-7752.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1322-3259-7752.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Council of Reeds triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.
1322-3259-7752.notes: If you start the combo with multiple Council of Reeds, you'll create a token for each of them. This'll result in you creating more tokens each loop for infinite tokens.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a creature you control

1987-4423-5243-7434.description:
Activate Mystic Sanctuary and Brass Infiniscope by tapping them, adding {C}{C}{U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker either from your hand or from the top of your library by paying {2}{U}, blinking Mystic Sanctuary and Brass Infiniscope.
When Mystic Sanctuary enters untapped, it triggers, putting Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Repeat.
1987-4423-5243-7434.notes: Each activation of Brass Infiniscope adds a delayed triggered ability that can draw you cards and gain life if you cast a spell with {X} in its cost. If you wish to use these abilities, you'll want to stop the combo before getting too many triggers such that you'll deck yourself and lose the game. To gain life, you must spend at least {2} for X when casting the spell.

2034-5220-6705-6961-7396.description:
Activate Survey Mechan by sacrificing it.
When Survey Mechan dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Survey Mechan from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Quintorius, History Chaser triggers, creating two creature tokens.
Resolve the Survey Mechan ability, dealing 3 damage to any target and causing you to draw three cards and gain 3 life.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing the two creature tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Cast Survey Mechan by paying {4}.
Repeat.

147-5188-6798.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
147-5188-6798.description:
Cast Dread Return by paying its mana cost
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Dread Return.
Holding priority, activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Dread Return
Resolve the Dread Return copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

443-997-7084.easyPrerequisites:
You control a land.
You control another nonland creature.
443-997-7084.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing another nonland creature.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, Magus of the Bridge and Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger.
Resolve the Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Magus of the Bridge trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat.

2060-2092-5140-7267.description:
Activate Kenrith by paying {G}, putting two +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Activate Crystalline Crawler by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {G}.
Repeat.
2060-2092-5140-7267.notes:
You may place additional counters on Crystalline Crawler to get infinite mana, and then use that mana to activate Kenrith's abilities.
Once you have infinite mana, you may spend it on Kenrith's other abilities.

5256-6662-7084.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Chocobo Racetrack triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.

57-3094-4846-5223.notablePrerequisites: You control any number of permanents that enter untapped and that can collectively tap to produce at least {4}{R}.
57-3094-4846-5223.description:
Activate any number of permanents by tapping them, adding at least {4}{R}.
Activate Feldon by paying {2}{R} and tapping it, targeting Worldgorger Dragon.
Holding priority, activate Lithoform Engine by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Feldon's ability targeting Worldgorger Dragon.
Resolve the copy of Feldon's ability, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token enters, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
Resolve the Feldon ability from step 2, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token enters, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token created in step 4 leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning all cards exiled with it to the battlefield.
Repeat.

2034-5571-7046--6.description:
Donate Blightbeetle to an opponent
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the undying creature.
When the undying creature dies, its undying ability triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to Blightbeetle.
Repeat from step 2.

141-5231-6817.description:
Cast Presumed Dead by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, copying Presumed Dead, with the copy targeting Naru Meha.
Resolve the copy of Presumed Dead.
Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing Naru Meha.
When Naru Meha dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

3220-3705-5231-6896.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Squee, adding {R}.
When Squee dies, Golgari Germination triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing the creature token, adding {R}.
Cast Squee from your graveyard by paying {R}{R} due to Green Goblin.
Repeat.

4565-4968-6919.description:
Cast Strength of Will by paying {1}{G}, targeting Deathbringer Thoctar.
Activate Deathbringer Thoctar by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to it.
Deathbringer Thoctar triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it due to Ozolith, the Shattered Spire.
Activate Deathbringer Thoctar by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat from step 2.
4565-4968-6919.notes: You can skip step 4 if desired.

Activate a basic land by tapping it, adding {1}.

Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Traxos triggers, untapping itself.
Repeat.

392-3292-3892-6791.description:
Cast Spear Spewer by paying {R}.
Birgi triggers, adding {R}.
Activate Spear Spewer by tapping it, dealing 1 damage to each player.
Dissipation Field triggers, returning Spear Spewer from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
392-3292-3892-6791.notes: It is recommended to perform this combo when you have more life than your opponents to end the game, but it is not required. If this combo will not end the game, stop once you have 1 life.

874-1170-4708-6862.easyPrerequisites: One of the artifacts must be in your hand, while the other is either in your graveyard or in your library.
874-1170-4708-6862.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one creature.
874-1170-4708-6862.description:
Cast the artifact in your hand by paying its mana cost.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Delivery Moogle.
When Delivery Moogle enters, it triggers, searching your library or graveyard for the other artifact and putting it into your hand.
Activate the artifact cast in step 1 by sacrificing it.
Repeat.

3086-3175-3967.description:
Cast Lagrella by paying {G}{W}{U}
When Lagrella enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Sun Titan until Lagrella leaves the battlefield.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Lagrella.
When Lagrella leaves the battlefield, Sun Titan is returned to the battlefield from exile.
When Sun Titan enters the battlefield, it and Lagrella triggers.
Resolve the Lagrella trigger, putting two +1/+1 counters on Sun Titan.
Resolve the Sun Titan trigger, returning Lagrella from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
Resolve all Yahenni abilities.

2438-2732-6132.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Metamorphosis Fanatic.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic dies, Prowling Geistcatcher's first ability triggers, exiling Metamorphosis Fanatic from your graveyard.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Prowling Geistcatcher.
When Prowling Geistcatcher dies, its second ability triggers, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from exile to the battlefield.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Prowling Geistcatcher from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.

974-1305-3750-4417-6674.description:
At the beginning of your precombat main phase, There and Back Again triggers, putting a lore counter on it and triggering its third chapter ability, creating a 6/6 Smaug legendary creature token and sacrifice There and Back Again.
Activate Rydia by paying {5} and tapping it, returning There and Back Again from your graveyard to the battlefield with a finality counter on it. As There and Back Again enters the battlefield, choose to have it enter with three lore counters due to its read-ahead ability.
There and Back Again's third chapter ability triggers. Holding priority, activate Hex Parasite by paying {1}{B/P}, removing the finality counter from There and Back Again.
Resolve the There and Back Again trigger, creating a 6/6 Smaug legendary creature token and sacrifice There and Back Again.
Put a Smaug token into your graveyard due to the legend rule, triggering its ability, creating fourteen Treasure tokens.
Activate twelve Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {9}{B}{R}{R}.
Activate Aggravated Assault by paying {3}{R}{R}, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an addditional combat and main phase after this one.
Repeat from step 2.

You control a mana-producing land.

Umbral Mantle attached to Incubation Druid.
2816-3990.description:
Activate Incubation Druid by tapping it, adding {3}.
Activate Incubation Druid by paying {3} and untapping it, giving it +2/+2 until end of turn.
Repeat.

1486-2136-2972-4600.notablePrerequisites: Orthion does not have summoning sickness.
1486-2136-2972-4600.description:
Activate Orthion's second ability by paying {6}{R}{R}{R} and tapping it, creating five token copies of Ganax.
When the Ganax tokens enter the battlefield, each Ganax triggers five times, creating 25 Treasure tokens.
Activate Magda by sacrificing five Treasures, searching your library for a Dragon card and putting it onto the battlefield.
When the Dragon enters the battlefield, each Ganax triggers, creating six Treasure tokens.
Repeat from step 3 until you have no Dragons remaining in your library.
1486-2136-2972-4600.notes: This combo will make some extra Treasures which you may use to activate Magda's ability a few extra times to fetch a few artifacts.

When Myr Battlesphere enters the battlefield, it and Soulherder's first abilities trigger.

Resolve the Myr Battlesphere trigger, creating four 1/1 Myr artifact creature tokens.

When Slaughter-Priest of Mogis enters the battlefield, Sethron and Cloudstone Curio trigger.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, choosing to return nothing to your hand.
Resolve the Sethron trigger, creating a 2/3 Minotaur creature token.
When the Minotaur token enters the battlefield, Cloudstone Curio triggers, returning Slaughter-Priest of Mogis to your hand from the battlefield.

Activate Metalwork Colossus by sacrificing the Treasure token and the Scrap token, returning Metalwork Colossus from your graveyard to your hand.

You have enough mana to cast the creature card in hand, minus {1}.
215-2436-2635.description:
Activate Marwyn by tapping it, adding an amount of {G} equal to Marwyn's power.
Cast any creature card in your hand with mana value seven by paying its mana cost.
Raggadragga's second ability triggers, untapping Marwyn and giving it +7/+7 until end of turn.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning the green creature with mana value seven from the battlefield to your hand.

1902-1978-3263.notablePrerequisites: There are at least three Elves on the battlefield.
1902-1978-3263.description:
Activate Wirewood Channeler by tapping it, adding at least {3}.
